prompt:
The image shows a brick-breaker playfield with labeled bricks at the top, a short ball-direction cue, and labeled catch lanes at the bottom. The short dashed arrow shows the ball's current straight direction. Report the label of the bottom catch lane where the ball arrives.
Required annotation format: set "annotation" to one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around the selected bottom catch lane pad.
Required answer format: set "answer" to the selected bottom lane label as a string.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[245,382,345,424]],"answer":"C"}
